name: Process: Run the read on the center: the seat's load line at every monthly domain read, the leads' read on the center at the partners' review, and the reset's second read
text_content:
I2, I6, I12, with rows 203, 204, and 213. The reading partner writes one line per mode per month on the founding seat from records only in the evidence line's form, the domain's owner answers on the page, and the line is read at the first partners' review of the month; with three partners the reader rotates so that no partner is another's standing reader; each lead writes their read on the center monthly on their own page naming mechanisms and no partner, the paired partner reads it at the monthly conversation, and the partners' review reads both leads' lines as a count and a theme; the reset runs the center's seats as its second read from the ledger and the year's lines, with the permitted and refused carriers, and compares each founder's prompt H signals with the year's lines as agreed or differed with no verdict. Extends 86akhpv5n, 86akhpuz8, 86akh676t, and 86akhb2jg by reference. High.

Filed by Session 16 of the Scaling People translation program. Session task 86ajgmjz6. Reasoning lives on the S16 page of the Sŏn Operating System doc 2ky45bmy-17253.
